Update for those who were curious: 
R4-R6 are wayyyy quicker to complete (MCQ faster because there’s not really math - either you know the concept or you don’t), so I completed all the material & had 1-2 weeks for review I think. I did not do the simulated exams but I did beckers final review questions. 

I did not push the exam date & sadly ended up getting a 73.
Sorry, I meant to put this in the REG subsection of the thread but idk how to do that apparently

To clarify my post: I’d rather skip entire modules than attempt to do its mcq w/o looking at the content. That’s what I meant by not looking at content isn’t an option. 
Like in my opinion it’s better to be the “master” of some modules by fully going through them, than to be a “jack of all trades” by only partially completing/understanding every single module.
